records.additional_information: A nomenclature mixed with a homophonic substitution cipher with up to 9 homophones for each letter ( generally more for vowels than for consonants), comprising of roughly 1800 codegroups in sum total. A one-part code: the numerical order of the codegroups follow the alphabetical order of the dictionary. Remarkable is the exessive presence of nulls: all numbers ranging from 1 to 500, 1118 to 1298, 1480 to 1599, 1900 to 1999 and 2600 to 2802.
